title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in El Salvador & Guatemala, implemented by partners ORMUSA, El Faro, UNES, ICEFI, CONGCOOP and ISD, supports women and marginalised groups to resist regressive human rights policies and strengthen their agency to advance community-based solutions and demand accountability. The objectives of the grant are to support marginalised groups to defend their land and human rights, and to support gender and inclusion at different levels, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. Objectives: Objective 1 - Rights Holders: Rights holders (women, men, groups, organisations, communities and peoples) are taking action to advance their rights Outcomes: Women, LGBTQ+, youth and indigenous groups and organizations i) are better able to resist regressive human rights policies and ii) have strengthened their agency to advance community-based solutions and demand accountability
